The default rule applies to tools without an individual rule. Allow runs automatically, Ask requests confirmation for each execution, and Forbid blocks execution.

Individual rules always take priority. Changing the default does not replace them. Allow, Ask, and Forbid can all be set individually. Only Use default removes an individual rule.

Search by name or description and filter by rule. Selections persist across searches and filters. Adding and batch editing affect only selected tools; cancelling saves nothing. Use Undo last change in the rules section to restore the last change made on this page. Save results use a brief toast.

These settings manage execution confirmation and do not replace Android system permissions.

Check the configuration: intervals must be at least 15 minutes and fit the supported range; Cron must contain five valid fields; dates must exist; an enabled plan must have a future occurrence before its end time.
When repeated, runs daily at this local time starting from the selected date. Otherwise runs once.
Repeat continues the interval or Cron rule. Turn it off to run only the next occurrence.
Leave blank for no deadline. Use local yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. No execution starts after this time.

Intervals wait the full duration after enabling or changing the plan, with a 15-minute minimum. Cron matches clock times in the current system time zone. Android WorkManager, sleep, battery restrictions, background limits, and queued tasks may delay execution; exact timing is not guaranteed. Reopen the app after force stopping to restore scheduling.
